author: 66sj
content: Result: M2 continuation complete. Added 931 lines across 11 files: glacial_step.wgsl (52 lines, latitude-based snowline gating), glacial.ts (snowline helpers), kernels.ts (WGSL loader for both erosion and glacial pipelines), pipeline.ts (coupled iteration loop), index.ts (barrel), worker.ts runErosion API, Globe.tsx 3 new layer toggles (bedrock/sediment/timeSinceUplift), appStore extended ViewLayer. Test suite: 24 new tests covering stream power, diffusion, glacial gating, hydrology stub, time-since-uplift, coupled iteration stability, underwater skip. All 101 tests pass, tsc --noEmit clean.
